spots.name: Teton Dam Scenic Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing northwest. Good for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Fall Creek Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.

spots.name: Palisades Waterfall
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.

spots.name: Bear Creek Hot Spring
spots.tip: Steam reads best in cold air at first light. Check access rules; many springs are on private or tribal land.

spots.name: Grays Lake National Wildlife Refuge
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Egin Bench
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.

spots.name: Bubble Bridge
spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure.
